sections.label: Four seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes through the people close to you.

You find money through other people, in a tip from a friend or a side venture with someone close. Because your openings arrive through people you trust, you say yes before you read the terms, and you earn in bursts more than in a steady line. The money you make fastest is the money you hold on to least.

You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.label: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You learned what things cost before most children do. Money at home was counted and spent with care, and by your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.label: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen you have put work, study and friends before money, and your income has stayed below what you could earn.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2030 · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your income starts to rise through the life you share with a partner, through a joint venture, a move or an opening from their side. You will earn more in these years than in all the years before, and you keep only what has both names written down.

sections.label: The Steward at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Your late forties are when years of steady saving finally show. Debts close and the accounts settle, and you become the one in your family who has enough.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · coming
sections.text: Younger people start to make claims on your money from your late forties. You will give more than you planned each time, and you will keep your own share only where you set its size before anyone asks.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: You turn steady work into something you own in these ten years, a home or savings or a share in something lasting. You keep more of what you earn than in any decade before it.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Money comes to you through openings in these years more than through regular pay, an offer or a sale or a well-timed move. You take more chances with money in this decade than you are used to, and most of them pay.

sections.label: 2031 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.label: Four seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You were fed well, and you became the one who feeds.

You hold your family together through comfort, the visit kept and the favour done and the table set. Because care reached you first as warmth, you give it back the same way, and you feel useless in a family crisis that kindness cannot touch. What you want from your family is ease, and you work hard to make it.

sections.label: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and promises kept, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Someone in your early life made comfort a daily thing, often an older relative who gave without being asked. You still judge a home by how it feels to walk into, and you have made yours warmer than the ones you grew up beside.

sections.label: The Steward at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your family leans on what you have built, and you give it calmly. You become the relative everyone trusts with arrangements, and you will find yourself saying out loud some of what your money already says.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2043 · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you will push against you and fight for you. You will find those years warmer and riskier than most people's, and you will be happiest in them when you have kept your own keys.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: You hold a proper place in your family in these years, as the reliable one with a role and a duty. You earn a standing among your relatives that lasts well beyond the decade.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Your family life settles in these years around the order you keep, a home that runs well and bills paid on time. You are the one your relatives rely on, and you are glad to be.

sections.text: Your family widens in these years, through new relatives, friends who become family or a household that keeps its door open. You spend more on the people around you than you used to, and you mind it less than you expected.

sections.label: 2029 · a Sage year
sections.text: A relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.label: 2030 · a Twin year
sections.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.

sections.label: 2032 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.label: Two seats rule Career in your chart. Both sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your work pays for what only you know.

You are the specialist people call when the usual answers fail. Because you trust knowledge you have dug out yourself, you are drawn to a narrow field the mainstream ignores, and you would rather be paid for strange work than praised for ordinary work. You earn more from the niche you choose than any ladder would pay you.
You also polish your work in private until the moment to show it has passed, and you lose more chances by not finishing than by failing.

sections.label: The Twin at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Since your late teens you have been the one handed the job nobody else would finish alone. You have changed teams or roles at least once because someone else took the credit for your work.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Your working life so far has run underground, in jobs that looked quiet while you were building a skill nobody asked for. At least once you won a role over a better-connected person because of something strange you knew.
Your later gates hold no Career seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Those years pulled you toward study and odd side paths more than toward steady work. You learned a great deal that did not pay at the time, and you got through on the one skill people kept asking you for.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042

sections.label: 2032 · an Artisan year

sections.label: Two seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Rising Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your friends are your equals, or they drift.

You choose friends who match you, people who carry their own weight and expect you to carry yours. Because you measure everyone against your own standard, you drift from anyone who leans on you, and you rarely say why. You keep a small circle, and you keep it for years.

sections.label: The Twin at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your friendships since your late teens have been between equals, often with one friend who mirrors you like a sibling. More than once you have lent money or time to a friend and found it harder to talk about than the friendship could bear.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2030 · coming
sections.text: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape these years through someone you share a home with.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: You hold standing among friends in these years, and people ask your opinion before they decide. You are the steady one in your circle, and you take the part seriously.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: You widen your circle in these years, through travel and new groups and the people they lead you to. You make more new friends in this decade than in the one before it.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.label: 2027 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations mark your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: 2030 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as peers this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.label: 2031 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year for the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.label: One seat rules Health in your chart. It sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your body trusts food and rest to put it right.

You trust your body to fix itself with a good meal and a long sleep, and for most of your life it has. Because comfort is how you recover, you reach for it under stress, and you turn the extra helping or the lost weekend into a habit before you notice. Your body asks you for rhythm more than for effort.
In your heaviest thinking seasons you also forget to eat and sleep properly, and your body tells you before your mind admits it.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: You were a child who recovered quickly, from colds and falls and bad days alike. Your appetite and your sleep were steady, and you came into adulthood with more reserve than most of the people around you.
Your later gates hold no Health seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.

sections.label: 2026 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: 2029 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.label: 2032 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You fall for people who widen your life.

In love you fall for the one with plans and friends and somewhere to be. Because range is what draws you, you lose interest within months in a partner who only offers closeness. What you want is someone who brings the world home, and you grow restless with anyone who shuts it out.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2030 · coming
sections.text: Your Home Chapter opens in your mid-thirties, and it is when love and money start to move together. You build a home in these years with someone who brings an opening into your life, and you stay for as long as the two of you keep heading somewhere together.
Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

sections.label: One seat rules Mind in your chart. It sits in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your mind runs best on what others find strange.

You think best alone, on problems other people have given up on or never noticed. Because you trust only the conclusions you reached alone, you rework a problem long after others have moved on, and you find small talk harder than hard questions. You keep most of what you know to yourself, and it is often the thing that matters most.
You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: From your late teens your mind went its own way, into a subject or a method most people around you did not follow. You have spent more nights with a question than with company, and you would not trade them back.
Your later gates hold no Mind seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: You turned inward in those years, into subjects few people around you shared. You spent long stretches alone with your thinking, and you came out of it with work that still feels like the most important you have done.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: You turn your thinking outward in these years, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.

sections.label: 2028 · an Alchemist year

sections.label: 2029 · a Sage year

sections.label: One seat rules Growth in your chart. It sits in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: You grow late, and mostly in private.

You grow in long quiet stretches that look like standing still, and then you change all at once. Because you change on the inside first, the people around you often underrate where you are, and you let them. You are further along than anyone watching would guess.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Since your late teens your growth has looked slow from the outside, years spent studying or testing or changing direction while friends settled. Most of what you can do now, you taught yourself in those years.
Your later gates hold no Growth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: You grew in those years by going your own way, away from what was expected of you. The progress was real and nearly invisible, and you kept going on your own conviction while you felt behind.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You grow fastest in these years through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You come out of the decade stronger in the places that used to hold you back.

sections.label: 2026 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: 2028 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Private study and unusual interests change you this year in ways few people see, and you become more yourself out of public view.

sections.label: 2030 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.text: Outside pressure protects it, a boss or a rule or a deadline, and you meet that pressure in your decades now and next.

You earn best from timing, a bonus or a sale or a deal that comes good all at once. Because you trust the next chance to arrive, you spend and lend freely between windfalls. Your money leaves as easily as it arrives, and you notice only when a quiet season comes.

What you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play. In you making and earning sit close together, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.label: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Good years and thin ones have followed each other since your late teens, with money arriving in lumps and leaving through generosity. More than once you have spent a windfall on friends and new plans before you set a share of it aside.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2031 · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your income starts to rise through the life you share with a partner, through a joint venture, a move or an opening from their side. You will earn more in these years than in all the years before, and you keep only what has both names written down.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · coming
sections.text: Chances to earn keep reaching you from your late forties, through younger people or through a move. Your money stays lively in these years, and you sleep best when one part of it is never touched.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.label: 2028 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.label: 2029 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.label: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your career rises on what you have studied.

You are trusted at work because you know your subject properly, and people check their facts with you. Because depth matters more to you than visibility, you leave the self-promotion to others, and promotion reaches you later than your knowledge has earned it. Your standing grows slowly and holds when louder careers fall away.
Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.

sections.label: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your best career moves since your late teens have come through timing, a job heard about early or an offer made in a casual conversation. You have changed direction more than once because a better chance turned up.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Your progress at work since your late teens has come through what you studied, each qualification earned before you asked for the next step. At least once someone senior recommended you before you felt ready, and you have proved them right.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: Your working life turns productive in the ways that suit you from your late forties, through mentoring and making and work done for others. You do some of your best work in these years, and you are paid for it in thanks as well as money.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Work came easily in those years, especially work that let you make things or please people. You did your best at a relaxed pace, and others valued what you produced.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: Original work brings you recognition in these ten years. You win people over by doing what others will not, and your reputation grows on your own terms.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Rivalry over shared work costs you energy in these years, and a joint effort takes more from you than it pays. You get through on work that is plainly yours, and the people who matter see that you did it.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Your work wanders in these years between study and side projects, and steady output is hard to keep up. You get through on one skill people pay for, and you return to it each time a side path stalls.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

sections.label: 2028 · a Steward year
sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, and you carry more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: A demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work this year, and you hold up under it better than anyone expects.

sections.label: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You were loved at home in an unusual way.

You show love to your family through ideas and help with problems more than through surface warmth. Because the care you got early was quiet and odd, you trust a relative who understands you more than one who fusses over you, and you feel lonely at noisy gatherings. You come home as the quiet one, and your relatives have stopped trying to change that.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: In your first home someone gave you books, questions or long silences in place of the usual fuss, an adult who lived in their own head. By your teens you had learned to answer your own questions, and you asked for help less than other children did.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties your family gathers around what you give, the meals and the gifts and the time. Younger people grow easy and generous around you, and you see the best of yourself in them.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you settle in different places and keep you travelling to see them. You become the reason they meet, and you find the gatherings worth more to you than anything you could buy them.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Home was warm in those years, full of meals and easy evenings with the people you lived with. You were the one who brought comfort to others, and your family loved you for it.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Pride runs through your family in these years, and each person insists on doing things their own way. The quarrels shrink once everyone has a clear part, and you come through by doing yours without keeping score.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Family care comes with conditions in these years, and help arrives with a say in your choices. You hold steady by keeping a way of your own without a quarrel, and the bond survives the distance you need.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.label: 2028 · a Steward year
sections.text: Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.

sections.label: 2029 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, and you spend more of your time and money on people beyond your own home.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.label: Three seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You know someone for every need.

You collect contacts the way other people collect friends, and you love introducing people who will get on. Because your network brings you work and money, the useful friendships and the warm ones get mixed together. You have lost a real friend at least once by treating them as a contact.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: When you were a child, your remarks were the ones repeated at family gatherings and in class. By your teens you had a few friends who loved your wit and a teacher or two who had given up on you.

sections.label: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Many of your friendships since your late teens began over work, a deal or a shared plan. You have kept in touch with more people than anyone you know, and a few of them have become close for life.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2031 · coming
sections.text: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. You will meet the people who shape these years through someone you share a home with.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: You become more outspoken in these years, and the people who like it like it a great deal. You gather an audience of your own, and you lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend above all others.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.label: 2029 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and introductions, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations mark your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: Three seats rule Mind in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: You learn steadily, and it never stops.

Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you rarely feel finished. You know far more than you claim to.
You also learn best when you can show what you learn, and you turn every course you finish into something you can say out loud.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You finished the work early at school and went looking for something harder, or for trouble when nothing harder came. Before you left school you had taught yourself at least one subject well beyond your class, and you had learned to hide how bored you were.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Whatever you were given to read when you were small, you read past it into subjects nobody around you shared. By your teens you knew more about a few odd things than most adults did, and you mentioned it only to the one or two people who asked.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Learning has carried you since your late teens, through courses and qualifications and the teachers who took an interest. You have stayed a student in some form ever since, and it has kept you steadier than most people around you.
Your later gates hold no Mind seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: You turn your thinking outward in these years, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Your mind turns inward in these years, and long stretches of solitary thought leave work half done. One person who hears your ideas keeps you steady, and you finish more when someone is waiting.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: You study more than you act in these years, and your thinking turns cautious. Work that puts what you know to use carries you through, and you trust your own ideas again once you see them working.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against the ideas you are handed this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.label: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your growth waits on a readiness you already have.

Each step you take comes after the training is done and the support is in place. Because shelter feels like the right place to prepare, you stay in comfortable roles past the point they teach you anything, and you wait for one more sign that you are ready. You are readier than you feel, and you have been for a long time.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: A person outside the usual line taught you most as a child, a neighbour or relative with odd interests who took you seriously. By your teens you had grown in ways your family could not quite follow, and you had stopped expecting them to.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: From your late teens you have grown in steady steps, each one taken only after you felt well prepared. You have stayed somewhere safe for longer than it served you at least once, and you did better than you feared once you finally moved.
Your later gates hold no Growth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. One equal who works beside you instead of against you keeps you going, and you grow because of it.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Solitary searching slows you in these years, with many interests started and few carried through. One finished project gets you through, and you feel the decade's progress most on the day it is done.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You fall for people who widen your life.

In love you fall for the one with plans and friends and somewhere to be. Because range is what draws you, you lose interest within months in a partner who only offers closeness. What you want is someone who brings the world home, and you grow restless with anyone who shuts it out.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2031 · coming
sections.text: Your Home Chapter opens in your mid-thirties, and it is when love and money start to move together. You build a home in these years with someone who brings an opening into your life, and you stay for as long as the two of you keep heading somewhere together.
Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

sections.label: No seat rules Health in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your health moves with the decade you are in.
Your health has no fixed pattern of its own. You feel well for some stretches of years and worn for others, and the change has no obvious cause because the decade is what moves it.
In your heaviest thinking seasons you also forget to eat and sleep properly, and your body tells you before your mind admits it.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Your appetite and sleep were good in those years, and ordinary pleasures kept you well. You ate with enjoyment and moved without strain, and you felt at ease in your own body.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Too much rest dulls you in these years, and comfortable days leave your energy low. What carries you is regular movement and a reason to get up early, and you feel better each time you have one.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: A Sage structure · 正印格
sections.text: Your chart rests on shelter and learning, on teachers who back you and places that look after their own. You do your best work where study is valued and someone senior vouches for you, and you repay that care with years of loyalty.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The Sage who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.label: Formed, under strain.
sections.text: Money pulls at your learning, and study keeps losing out to whatever pays this month. You trade courses and mentors for earnings, and the shelter behind you wears thinner each time.

sections.label: what protects it
sections.text: Outside pressure protects it, a boss or a rule or a deadline, and you supply that pressure yourself because no decade of yours brings it.
Water alone carries more than half of your chart, and you live mostly through what you think.

sections.label: no Twin · it arrives with your decade 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Your chart has no Twin, and nobody inside it stands level with you or carries half the load. You find your footing through other people, a team or a close friend, and you stand firmest when someone stands beside you.

sections.label: no Steward · your season asks for it too · your Steward decade 2002 to 2011 is lived
sections.text: Your chart gives the Steward no place, and nobody inside it keeps the books or counts what comes in. You handle money in bursts and forget it for months, and you rely on a partner or a spreadsheet to keep track.

sections.label: no Magistrate · no decade of yours brings it
sections.text: No Magistrate sits in your chart, and nobody inside it tells you what the rules are. You borrow structure from a boss or a contract, and you work best once someone else has fixed the terms.

sections.label: 十月乙
sections.text: Early winter brings cold water up around your roots, more than a vine can take in, and growth stops. The month turns to Fire first to warm you and then to Earth as solid ground to hold back the water and give you footing. You stay above the flood when warmth and firm ground reach you together.

sections.label: first need · 丙, the Virtuoso · on show
sections.text: The Virtuoso your season asks for is on show, and you are known for a sharp voice and work that breaks the usual mould.

sections.label: the Virtuoso
sections.text: You come across as quick and outspoken, the one who says what the rest of the meeting was thinking.

sections.label: the Horizon
sections.text: You come across as easy with strangers and quick with an offer, the one who always knows someone useful.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You come across as easygoing and warm, the friend who cooks for everyone and makes hard work look light.

sections.label: the Alchemist
sections.text: You think in strange directions and keep most of those thoughts to yourself.

sections.label: the Sage
sections.text: You want to be looked after more than you say, and you stay close to the people who once taught you.

sections.label: the Horizon
sections.text: You keep a second plan that nobody has heard about, and you want more open roads than you admit.
Only the people you live with meet the second list.

sections.label: The Virtuoso harnessed by the Sage · 伤官配印
sections.text: Your sharpest talent has years of study behind it, and you are known for being both daring and right.

sections.label: The Alchemist starves the Artisan · 枭神夺食
sections.text: Your thinking outweighs your making, and you study a thing so long that the moment to make it passes.

sections.label: The maker’s economy · 食伤生财
sections.text: Things you make sell without much pushing, and you earn the most from the projects you would have done for nothing.

sections.label: Day binds with Year · 子丑合
sections.text: You build your own home close to the habits of the one you grew up in, and you return to them more than you expected.

sections.label: Hour binds with Year · 子丑合
sections.text: You pass the customs of your first family to the young people you raise or train, and your later years come to resemble your earliest ones.
No clashes, punishments or harms sit between your gates, and you argue with yourself less than most people do.

sections.label: Four seats rule Career in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, two in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your work pays for reading where things are going.

You are drawn to work where timing matters, buying and selling or finding things before others notice them. Because you read change early, a job where nothing moves bores you, and you leave it sooner than you planned. In any role you end up as the person who sees what is coming next.
Underneath, you do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.

sections.label: The General at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Responsibility beyond your age came to you before you were grown, a job at home or a team to lead or younger children to mind. The weight felt heavy at the time, and you came out of it more capable than most of your friends.

sections.label: The General at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your reputation at work has grown out of hard moments since your late teens, the emergency handled or the project rescued. You were promoted at least once for the steadiness you showed in a bad week.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: The jobs that have gone best for you since your late teens are the ones where you could spot a trend early, in sales or trading or finding the right people. More than once you have left a steady job because it gave your instinct nothing to do.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your work has turned since your late forties toward teaching, hosting or finishing projects you had put off for years. Some of what you have made in this stretch has been better received than anything from your busier decades, and you have been surprised by it.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Safety kept you in one place too long during those years, and your duties grew faster than your reward. You carried the extra load reliably, and it earned you a trust that later work paid for.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: Comfort dulled your drive at work in those years, and easy work held you longer than it served you. You were well liked and under-stretched, and the skill you practised for pleasure is what kept you going.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: Authority pushes back on you in these years, and a frank remark costs more than it used to. Work that is yours alone carries you through, and you do better outside a strict chain of command.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Joint efforts carry your work in these ten years, and you do best inside a group with something to win. You compete hard and share credit fairly, and the people beside you back you for it.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your work loosens and pleases people this year, and you get paid more readily for what you enjoy making.

sections.label: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your family spreads wide and gathers in bursts.

You love your family best when everyone is together for a few loud days, and you plan those days months early. Because distance has never felt like loss to you, long gaps between visits pass without worry. You give the people close to you many short visits and few long stays.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: A parent or an older relative looked after you closely when you were small, and you came to rely on their calm. By your teens you expected the world to treat you with the same care, and mostly it did.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: You have become the relative who hosts since your late forties, the one whose home younger people head for at holidays. The people after you have picked up your habits of giving, and you see yourself in how they treat their own guests.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Your family has scattered across more than one place since your late forties, and the younger ones live far from you and from each other. You have become the one who brings them together, and your best days in these years have been reunions.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Plans and people far from home pulled you away in those years, and your family saw less of you than they wanted. You made it up in bursts of generosity, and you came through because your family forgave more than you expected.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Duty at home outweighed pleasure in those years, and you counted what others spent without meaning to. The household stayed secure and a little tense, and you were carried by one relative who thanked you plainly.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: During those years you gave your family more comfort than they asked for, and some of them came to expect it. You spoiled the people closest to you, and you got your own ease back once others began to care for you in turn.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Your family runs on shared effort in these ten years, and each person at home carries a fair part. You do your share before anyone asks, and relatives come to you as one equal to another.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.

sections.label: Three seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your friends are people who have earned it.

You keep a circle of people who have proved themselves, colleagues who stood with you when the work was hard. Because respect comes first for you, you leave a party once you have talked to the people you came for, and light talk feels like a waste of time. Your friendships are few and serious, and the people in them stay loyal for years.

sections.label: The General at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were the one others looked to in a fight or a dare, and you did not give way easily. Your friends by your teens were either as tough as you or kept at a distance, and you learned diplomacy slowly.

sections.label: The General at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your closest friends since your late teens have been the people you worked hardest beside, in a tough job or a demanding team. Some acquaintances found you too intense and drifted off, and you kept the ones who stayed.

sections.label: The Twin inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: So far your closest friendships have been between equals, people who did not need you to rescue them. You gave less time to the friends who wanted looking after, and you kept the level ones.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Acquaintances crowded those years, and you knew people in many places without letting many of them close. One old friend who stayed kept you steady, and you confided in that friend more than in anyone new.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: Bluntness strains your friendships in these years, and some people take offence at what you meant as wit. The friends who stay value your candour, and you find them worth more than a wide circle.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Your friends in these ten years are equals, people with their own lives and their own strength. Your circle stays small and solid, and you trust it more than any crowd.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Rivalry turns friendly in these years, and people who compete with you end up on your side. You keep a busy circle through the decade, one where you give and receive in fair measure.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.label: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes in strong seasons and quiet ones.

You earn in bursts, a run of good months and a quiet stretch after. Because each good season makes you sure of the next, you spend the winnings on a new chance before you have kept any. You are richer in the middle of each good stretch than after it.
You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: What you have earned since your late teens has followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. At least once you have lost the gains of a good year by chasing a better one, and you have learned how your own streaks run.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Your money since your late forties has gone into travel, new projects and the plans of younger people more than into reserves. You have earned well from at least one late venture, and you have spent a good part of it on getting people together.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Easy money came and went in those years, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once, and what carried you was the one steady source you kept.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Expenses felt heavy in those years, and you counted money long after there was enough. Your savings grew while your pleasure shrank, and you came through on the security that careful habit built.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Shared money works for you in these ten years, because the contest with others keeps you sharp. You do better with people at your side than alone, and you keep a fair part of what you win together.

sections.label: One seat rules Health in your chart. It sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your body recovers best when someone looks after you.

You get your energy back quickly after tiring weeks and bad nights, and faster still when someone close is fussing over you. Because care was what restored you from the start, you let yourself rest properly only when another person insists. Your body does well on trust, rest and good company.
Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived

You save a part of everything you earn, and a steady rise in your accounts pleases you more than any windfall. Because security is what you are working for, you avoid risks that would make you rich quickly. Your caution keeps you safe, and you feel a good year as relief more than as joy.

You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people. In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

sections.label: The Rival at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Money arrived and vanished in your family while you were growing up, a good year followed by a hard one. You had your own share of that nerve before you were grown, and you spent what you had almost as soon as you had it.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Money in your family came through moving when you were young, a relative working away or a business that travelled. The first money you made yourself came from beyond your own neighbourhood, and you liked how that felt.

sections.label: The Steward inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Even in lean months you have put money aside since your late teens, and your savings have grown more than people expected. You have turned down at least one exciting offer because it asked too much risk.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Openings came your way in those years, a timely move or a chance offer or someone who knew someone. Money reached you by routes regular pay never took, and you grew bolder with it.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: Other people reach for your money in these years, through loans, shared costs and favours that do not all come back. You keep enough because you set your own share aside first, and you spend less on proving yourself.

sections.label: 2026 · a Steward year
sections.text: Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.label: 2027 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.label: 2032 · a Rival year
sections.text: Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.

sections.label: Two seats rule Career in your chart. Both sit in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your career grows slowly and keeps growing.

You do your best work in a job you can stay in and get better at, with clear tasks and fair pay. Because you value what you can explain and defend, you distrust shortcuts and the people who take them. You are underrated in the early years of any role, and you outlast most of the people who underrated you.

You are also paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing. In you making and earning sit close together, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Through your first working years your best jobs were the ones you enjoyed, and your worst stretches were the ones you forced yourself through. At least once a parent or an older colleague took your ease for a lack of drive, and you proved them wrong quietly.

sections.label: The Steward inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Your working life has moved forward one step at a time since your late teens, with each job adding a skill you kept. More than once you have overtaken people who started faster than you.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: Your work gains structure in these ten years, a clear role with real responsibility. You are trusted with more than before, and the trust lasts beyond the work that earned it.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You take on hard assignments and real pressure in these years, and you rise because of them. You come out of the decade with more authority than you went in with.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Unusual knowledge brings you work in these years, through research, advice or technical skill. You become the one people ask about what others do not know, and your name grows inside a small field.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: Rivalry over shared work costs you energy in these years, and a joint effort takes more from you than it pays. You get through on work that is plainly yours, and the people who matter see that you did it.

sections.text: Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.label: 2032 · a Rival year
sections.text: A colleague or partner reaches for the same credit this year, and you keep your share by naming it before anyone else does.

sections.label: Two seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You become the host your family returns to.

Your home is where your family ends up, for meals and holidays and the nights someone needs a bed. Because a full house makes you feel settled, you take on more hosting than anyone asks of you. Relatives treat your door as always open, and you rarely show them how tired you are by the end.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: In your first home people spoke of a relative who had moved away, or you moved yourself and made friends quickly in each new place. By the time you were grown your family stretched across more than one place, and you felt at home in each of them.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2037 · coming
sections.text: Your house becomes the place your family gathers once you are past your mid-thirties, and relatives and friends treat it as a second home. Quarrels in the family get settled over your meals, and you become the relative everyone means when they say home.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Your household opened outward in those years, through travel, new relatives or friends who became family. You gave generously to everyone at home, and the house was busier for it.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: You hold a proper place in your family in these years, as the reliable one with a role and a duty. You earn a standing among your relatives that lasts well beyond the decade.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Family support reaches you in these ten years, as advice, practical help or a place to come back to. You receive more care than you expected, and you return it to the people who gave it.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2073 to 2082
sections.text: Pride runs through your family in these years, and each person insists on doing things their own way. The quarrels shrink once everyone has a clear part, and you come through by doing yours without keeping score.

sections.label: 2028 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.

sections.label: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: A relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.

sections.label: Two seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your easy manner wins you friends at work.

You put people at ease without trying, and a tense meeting turns friendly once you join it. Because sharing food and good company is how you connect, much of your working circle began over a lunch or a drink. You know more people than you realise, and you are slow to ask any of them for a favour.

sections.label: The Rival at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were popular with other children and with adults, and you were invited to more than your share. By the time you were grown you had a wide circle and one or two close friends who mattered far more, and you knew which were which.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Your closest friends at work since your late teens have come out of shared breaks and long evenings, the colleagues you ate with. More than once a friendly contact has turned into a job or an opening, and you had not been looking for either.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 2013 to 2022
sections.text: Your circle spread wide in those years, through travel, work and friends of friends. You met people easily everywhere you went, and several of them opened doors for you.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2023 to 2032 · now
sections.text: You hold standing among friends in these years, and people ask your opinion before they decide. You are the steady one in your circle, and you take the part seriously.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2063 to 2072
sections.text: Comparison runs through your friendships in these years, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. What carries you is one friend who never competes with you, and you lean on that friend above all others.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2073 to 2082
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce in these years, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. One steady friend carries you through the decade, and you value that friend more than a full calendar.

sections.label: 2027 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and introductions, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.label: 2028 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations mark your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: 2032 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year for the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.label: One seat rules Health in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your body does well when home is calm.

Your health follows your home life closely, and you sleep and eat well in the seasons when the house is peaceful. Because tension at home reaches your body before you name it, a bad month with a partner shows up in your appetite and your rest. You recover fastest through ordinary comfort, a shared meal and an early night.

sections.label: Rising Chapter · 16 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: Since sixteen your body has come second to work and study, and you have been spending the reserve your childhood gave you.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2037 · coming
sections.text: Your sleep and appetite steady from your mid-thirties as your household settles, and a calm year at home gives you more energy than a busy one. In the fullest of these years you eat and rest in step with whoever shares your home, and you stay well because of it.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Support and good rest restore you in these ten years, and you recover quickly from strain. You sleep well and eat well, and your energy holds steady through the decade.

sections.label: 2029 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You show love by making life easy.

You love by doing, the meal made and the evening kept free and the worry taken off someone's hands. Since giving comfort is how you feel close, you feel most loved by a partner who receives it gladly and gives some back. You give without keeping count, and you are the last of your friends to notice a partner who only takes.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2037 · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your love life settles into a shared home with a partner who makes ordinary days pleasant. The two of you build your life around the same table, and you find yourself looked after in return more than at any time before.
Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

sections.label: No seat rules Mind in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your thinking changes character with each decade.

Your thinking has no fixed shape of its own. It changes character with each decade, studious in one and restless or practical in another, and you notice the change in what you read before you notice it in yourself.
Your Hour Gate can hold a Mind seat, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Learning comes easily in these years, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, and you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Your intuition is sharp in these ten years, and unusual ideas find a use. You think in ways few others do, and people come to you for the angle they missed.

sections.label: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.

sections.label: 2031 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Odd, specialist subjects pull at your thinking this year, and you study alone what few people around you would think to ask about.

Your growth keeps no steady pace of its own. You change fast in some decades and stand still in others, and you rarely notice which kind you are in until it ends.
Your Hour Gate can hold a Growth seat, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You grow fastest in these years through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You come out of the decade stronger in the places that used to hold you back.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Private study pays in these years, and the things you taught yourself count for more. You grow in directions nobody planned for you, and the progress shows in work only you could do.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2073 to 2082
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard in these years, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves little ease. One equal who works beside you instead of against you keeps you going, and you grow because of it.

sections.label: 2029 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: 2031 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Private study and unusual interests change you this year in ways few people see, and you become more yourself out of public view.

sections.text: Your chart is built around money kept and value earned. You do best when the work in front of you has a clear return, and you trust a slow sure gain over a fast one.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The Steward who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.text: Outside pressure protects it, a boss or a rule or a deadline, and you meet that pressure in your decades now and next.
Fire and Wood carry two thirds of your chart, and you live mostly through what you earn and what you make.

sections.label: no Twin · it arrives with your decade 2073 to 2082
sections.text: Your chart has no Twin, and nobody inside it stands level with you or carries half the load. You find your footing through other people, a team or a close friend, and you stand firmest when someone stands beside you.

sections.text: Your chart carries no Virtuoso, and nobody inside it argues back or tells you a plan is wrong. You follow the brief as written, and you raise objections late and politely, after the decision is made.

sections.label: no Alchemist · your season asks for it too · it arrives with your decade 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Nobody inside your chart pulls you toward odd subjects or second thoughts, because it holds no Alchemist. You take knowledge as it is taught, and you act on a straight answer before you think to question it.

No clashes, punishments or harms sit between your gates, and you argue with yourself less than most people do.

sections.text: Your family trusts your word completely.

You look after your family by keeping everything in order, the papers sorted and the promises kept. Because reliability is how you express love, you are more at ease arranging things for people than talking about feelings. Your family depends on that order, and they know less of your heart than of your plans.

sections.text: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and promises kept, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.

sections.text: In your first home you carried a weight few people saw, a strict rule or a hard stretch or a worry beyond your age. By your teens you were the steady one in your family, and you kept your own needs to yourself.

sections.text: You have become the relative who hosts since your late forties, the one whose home younger people head for at holidays. The people after you have picked up your habits of giving, and you see yourself in how they treat their own guests.

sections.text: The people after you have relied on your word without checking it since your late forties. You have settled matters for them quietly and in good time, and few of them have seen how much you handled.

sections.text: Care surrounded you in those years, from family who put your needs first and helped without being asked. You felt protected, and that security gave you the nerve to take on more than before.

sections.text: Obligations at home pile up in these years, with duties to the people who rely on you and a family name to protect. You meet them faithfully, and you guard a part of your life that belongs to you alone.

sections.text: You do your best work under real pressure.

You pick the job with the highest stakes and the tightest deadlines, and you are at your sharpest when it is going badly for everyone else. Because pressure is how you prove yourself to yourself, calm work leaves you flat and restless. What you build fastest is respect, and what you lose first is rest.
Underneath, you do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Bosses have either backed you fully or tried to slow you down since your late teens, and few have stayed neutral about you. You have done your best work for the ones who believed in you, and you have outstayed most of the ones who did not.

sections.label: The General inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: A calm post has left you uneasy since your late teens, as if you had not earned your place, and you have asked for the hard assignment instead. Each crisis you took on left you more trusted, and at least once you turned down an easier job with better hours.

sections.text: Your work has turned since your late forties toward teaching, hosting or finishing projects you had put off for years. Some of what you have made in this stretch has been better received than anything from your busier decades, and you have been surprised by it.

sections.text: Your work in those years was a contest, and you did best when someone else wanted the same result. You were sharpest with a rival close by, and that drive got you further than talent alone.

sections.text: Unusual work suited you in those years, the kind that needs odd knowledge and long hours alone. You became good at something few others understood, and it earned you respect before it earned you anything else.

Because loyalty to the person beside you outweighs any careful plan, the shared accounts blur and the arguments arrive later. You stay calmest about money when your share and theirs are kept apart, and you seldom manage it.
You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

sections.label: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You learned what things cost before most children do. Money at home was counted and spent with care, and by your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: Your money has risen and fallen with the people you lived with, generous seasons followed by tight ones. You have paid for a partner's plans more than once, and you found it easier to give than to talk about it afterwards.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: Since your late forties the people after you and your own time have come before earning more, and you have measured money by what it lets you give.

sections.text: Your body carries the cost of your pace.

You run on adrenaline through long weeks and notice the tiredness only when the pressure lifts. Because effort is where you feel most like yourself, you push through poor sleep as if it were part of the job. Your energy is deep, and you spend it faster than you replace it.
Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

sections.label: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: You were a tough child, slow to complain and quick to hide a bad night from the adults. Your reserves got you through hard weeks most children did not have to face, and you learned early to run on them.

sections.label: The General inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: Through your first working years your body kept pace with demands that stopped most people around you. A hard season ended more than once with you worn out for weeks, and you recovered fully each time you gave yourself real rest.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: Since your late forties your attention has gone to others and to work more than to your body, and you have felt your energy follow the decade you are in.
