sections.text: Pressure costs you sleep and energy through these years, and short nights add up faster than you notice. What carries you is rest and slow meals given their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.

sections.label: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.

sections.label: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grow later by refining what you value.

You grow by doing familiar things better, holding the same values to a higher standard. Because consistency matters to you, you would rather redo a thing properly than try something new, and the change in you shows up as patience. You redo a job nobody else would have noticed was wrong, and you feel better for it.

sections.label: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Each hard year of your childhood left you more capable than the one before, at school or at home or in a sport. You came to trust difficulty more than ease, and by your teens you went looking for it.

sections.label: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Your growth since your late forties has been steady and private, a practice deepened or a standard raised year by year. You became more patient in that time, and the people around you noticed it before you did.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Your progress in those years came from peers who were your equals, people you learned beside more than beneath. You set your own standard and met it, and the confidence lasted.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Unconventional paths taught you most in those years, a strange course, a self-taught skill or a mentor outside the usual. You developed in your own direction, and the difference became your strength.

sections.label: A General decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Setbacks arrive in these years without warning, and you are pushed before you feel ready. What carries you is the discipline you already have, and you end the decade tougher in ways that show later.

sections.label: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.label: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You fall for people who push back.

Partners with a temper, an opinion and plans of their own are the ones you fall for. Because being challenged is how you know you matter to someone, a calm and agreeable partner bores you within months. You keep loving through the arguments, and you count a quiet week as a sign that something has gone wrong.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: The people you have loved were strong-willed and hard to predict, and they made you earn every point you won. At least one relationship of yours ran loud for years, with fights over plans and whose turn it was, and you stayed because it held your interest.
Love has no decade of its own. The pattern your Day Gate set is the one your love life keeps.

sections.label: One seat rules Social in your chart. It sits in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Friends and colleagues either love you or resist you.

Your circle splits quickly into people who champion you and people who resent you, with few in between. Because being remembered matters more to you than being liked, you say the sharp thing in company and lose a friend or two to it. Your loyal few have done more for your name than general approval could, and you keep them close for years.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Your friendships since your late teens have formed around strong reactions, people who liked your edge at once or never warmed to it. More than once a friendship ended over something you said in public, and you have kept every friend who stayed through it.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 1984 to 1993
sections.text: Those years filled your life with lively company, friends who competed with you and pushed you on. You were at your best among a crowd of rivals, and you won their respect openly.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Friendships among equals defined those years, with people who matched your pace and asked nothing extra. You found a few friends who met you level, and you have kept some of them since.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: Duty shapes your friendships in these years, and social life feels more like obligation than pleasure. Your good name holds, and you find relief with the friends who expect nothing formal from you.

sections.label: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Friends meet you as peers this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.

sections.label: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: Competition runs through your circle this year for the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.

sections.label: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.

sections.label: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and introductions, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.

sections.label: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Roles and expectations mark your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: No seat rules Mind in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your thinking changes character with each decade.

Your thinking has no fixed shape of its own. It changes character with each decade, studious in one and restless or practical in another, and you notice the change in what you read before you notice it in yourself.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Steady study suited you in those years, and people who knew more than you gave your learning a firm base. You absorbed knowledge patiently, and much of what you know best dates from that decade.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Strange subjects drew you in those years, and you learned through instinct and odd sources more than set courses. Your thinking grew original, and you trusted hunches that later proved right.

sections.label: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against the ideas you are handed this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.

sections.label: A General structure · 七杀格
sections.text: Your chart answers to pressure, the hard test and the person who pushes back. You rise when the risk is real and the deadline is close, and you are steadiest in the thick of a fight.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The General who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.label: Formed, under strain.
sections.text: The Magistrate sits beside your General, and you switch between fighting for ground and asking for it politely. People above you get mixed signals, and you lose credit that one clear approach would win.

sections.label: what protects it · Artisan decade 1974 to 1983
sections.text: What you make protects it, work you finish and show, and you found the time for it in decades now behind you.
Water and Earth carry three quarters of your chart, and you live mostly through what you answer to and what you make.

sections.label: no Twin · your Twin decade 1994 to 2003 is lived
sections.text: Your chart has no Twin, and nobody inside it stands level with you or carries half the load. You find your footing through other people, a team or a close friend, and you stand firmest when someone stands beside you.

sections.label: no Horizon · your season asks for it too · no decade of yours brings it
sections.text: With no Horizon in your chart, nobody inside it opens a side door or brings you an offer you did not chase. You earn by the front route, one job at a time, and you trust what you worked for over a windfall.

sections.label: no Sage · your Sage decade 2004 to 2013 is lived
sections.text: Your chart holds no Sage, and nobody inside it shelters you or praises you for trying. You learned early to reassure yourself, and you trust help more when you did not have to ask for it.

sections.label: 十月丙
sections.text: Early winter takes the sun out of season, with short days and cold water rising under you. The month wants Wood to keep your fire fed, Earth to hold back the water, and Metal to trim the Wood when it grows thick. You stay bright through the dark months by drawing on each of these as the weather changes.

sections.label: first need · 甲, the Alchemist · hidden deep
sections.text: The Alchemist your season asks for lies as a thin thread far beneath the surface, and you reach for strange knowledge only when ordinary answers run out.

sections.label: second need · 戊, the Artisan · on show
sections.text: The Artisan your season asks for sits out in the open, and you make things with an ease that everyone around you can see.

sections.label: support · 壬, the General · inside a branch, not on show
sections.text: The General your season asks for works unseen from within, and you hold yourself to a hard private standard that makes you stronger.

sections.label: the Steward
sections.text: You come across as a careful provider, the one who pays on time and keeps count.

sections.label: the Virtuoso
sections.text: You come across as quick and outspoken, the one who says what the rest of the meeting was thinking.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You come across as easygoing and warm, the friend who cooks for everyone and makes hard work look light.

sections.label: the General
sections.text: You push yourself harder in private than anyone asks of you, and you set tests that nobody else sees.

sections.label: the Rival
sections.text: You keep score with the people closest to you, and you want to win more than you let on.

sections.label: the Magistrate
sections.text: You hold yourself to rules nobody wrote down, and you want a clear title that is yours alone.
Only the people you live with meet the second list.

sections.label: The Artisan checks the General · 食神制杀
sections.text: A hard deadline settles you instead of rattling you, and you turn out your best work when the clock runs short.

sections.label: The Virtuoso confronts the Magistrate · 伤官见官
sections.text: Your talent argues with whoever is in charge, and you are at your sharpest where nobody signs off on every line.

sections.label: The peers contest the purse · 比劫夺财
sections.text: Equals and money share your chart, and you lose most where you share most, with friends and family and partners.

sections.label: Year and Month share 亥 · 自刑
sections.text: The role you played in your family returns at work, the peacemaker or the one who carries everything, and you change it once you see it twice.

sections.label: Hour clashes with Day · 子午冲
sections.text: The young people in your life pull against the home you share with a partner, and you move house or rework your days to keep both.
